title: Choose AfterDegree's visual world: bolder hand
question: A bolder hand, every card at full commitment. Keep the lead, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Your cohort, one cell per person, with the answer built monumental on a visible grid.
options.viewport: Saturated shell; '214' built from grid cells; a waffle of 312 cells where each lit cell is a person like you abroad.
options.risk: Monumental type can crowd the working tables if the grid is not held strictly.

raised.raise: Hairline precision: every rule and bracket drawn at one pixel, one rubric colour reserved for evidence keys.
Selection inverts: the chosen cohort cell or row flips to its negative, nothing else changes.

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: Every screen is a junction sign: your next decision in monumental type, with how far each route takes.
options.viewport: A yellow sign band across the top naming your next decision; destinations as signed routes with years and people counts.
options.case: Students going abroad feel it instantly and it makes the next step the hero; beats the lead on both axes.
options.risk: Yellow everywhere tires the eye unless tables sit on calm panels below the bands.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: People like you mapped as a night sky: bigger stars are where more of them went.
options.viewport: A navy chart of destinations and employers sized by count, constellation lines for common routes, your target ringed in red.
options.case: Beautiful and aspirational with clear size ranking; less instantly familiar than wayfinding.
options.risk: Dark chart pages can hide tables if contrast and type size are not generous.

options.label: Streaming Wall
options.thesis: Browse futures like shows: rows of routes and destinations, the focused one opens up.
options.viewport: Rows: 'Where people like you went', 'Companies that hire people like you', 'Routes that fit you'; one tile expanded with its numbers.
options.case: Instantly familiar to young users; weaker for dense comparison and for universities.
options.risk: Needs authored tile artwork; without it the wall turns into dark grey boxes.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.thesis: Results set like an annotated edition.
options.viewport: Two dense columns around a rail of keys.
options.case: Too scholarly for students and parents; loses both axes.
options.kept: One-pixel ruling precision and a single rubric colour for evidence.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Outcomes as a strobing data field.
options.case: Cold and hard to read for a warm mentor product; loses both axes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean career-analytics product, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, greeting, KPI cards and charts for your cohort.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other analytics products by design.
